summary: Strong, coherent set of 16 concrete AI stories for 2026-08-25, weighted toward open-source agentic releases, local/distributed AI hardware, and AI policy/labour impacts. Two same-topic-distinct-angle clusters (open-source agentic harnesses; local AI hardware) are acceptable as distinct products. The thsottiaux DevDay tweet is thin promotional hype with no concrete substance and overlaps the same person featured in the Berman interview; replacing it with the theallinpod open-source-AI-ban prediction adds a concrete, higher-engagement policy angle. All other items pass.
